gui.export.title: Export Options
gui.export.information: THIS FEATURE WILL BE REMOVED IN A FUTURE VERSION. A feature of Tails is the ability to allow other players to see your tail even if the server doesn't have the mod installed (The other player still needs Tails installed though). To do this, some unused pixels in your skin are used by Tails instead to store information about your tail. You can use the options below to choose where to export or whether to upload it straight to Minecraft skin servers. Hover over the buttons to see the file locations.
gui.button.livepreview.0.tooltip: Shows a live preview of your tail as you edit the values
gui.button.export.0.tooltip: Exports a modified version of your skin that has certain, unused pixels changed so others can see your tail without Tails being installed server side.
gui.button.export.tooltip: Exports a modified version of your skin to %s
gui.button.upload.tooltip: Uploads your skin. CAUTION: Opens your browser!
gui.button.openfolder.tooltip: Open the folder where you exported your skin to
gui.button.help.camera.0: Click and drag on the preview window
gui.button.picker.1: Select a point on the screen to use that colour
gui.button.share: Export to clipboard. Send the exported code to your friends to share!
